summary.text: Leon Lillie is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 44B, in office since January 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Unaffiliated candidate TJ Hawthorne. He chairs the Legacy Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Leon Lillie lives in North St. Paul, Minnesota.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Luther College, attended Nottingham University in the United Kingdom, and, according to Ballotpedia, has worked as a baggage handler for Northwest Airlines.
Lillie defeated Bill Dahn and TJ Hawthorne in the November 5, 2024, general election for District 44B.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Legacy Finance Committee.
